# RIZIQ

> RIZIQ (RIZIQ Inventions) is a research-led technology company that turns research into useful engineering systems, student and industry projects, and practical technical training.

RIZIQ helps businesses, colleges, faculty and students move from an idea to a working system. The company combines software, AI, IoT, robotics, embedded systems, mechanical and civil design support, MATLAB simulation, research publication guidance, and hands-on training.

## Key facts

- Legal name: RIZIQ Inventions
- Website: https://riziq.in

## Services

- [Software Development](https://riziq.in/services/software-development): custom web, mobile, cloud and integration software
- [AI & Machine Learning](https://riziq.in/services/ai-machine-learning): practical AI, computer vision, NLP and GenAI systems
- [IoT & Smart Systems](https://riziq.in/services/iot-solutions): sensors, Arduino, Raspberry Pi and monitoring systems
- [Robotics & Automation](https://riziq.in/services/robotics): robotics prototypes, motion control and automation concepts
- [Embedded Systems & VLSI](https://riziq.in/services/embedded-systems): firmware, FPGA, PCB and VLSI foundations
- [Training & Institutional Programs](https://riziq.in/services/training-workshops): student projects, workshops, FDP, CRT and CDC programs
- [Mechanical Engineering & CAD/CAE](https://riziq.in/services/mechanical-engineering-cad-cae): SolidWorks, CATIA, ANSYS, CAD and 3D printing preparation
- [MATLAB & Engineering Simulation](https://riziq.in/services/matlab-engineering-simulation): MATLAB, Simulink and system modelling
- [Civil Engineering & Design](https://riziq.in/services/civil-engineering-design): AutoCAD, Civil 3D and structural documentation
- [Research & Publications](https://riziq.in/services/research-publications): ethical research assistance, paper writing and publication readiness

## Who RIZIQ serves

Students, faculty, colleges, researchers, engineering teams and organizations that need project support, technical training or applied research help.

## Important answers

- Yes, RIZIQ provides engineering projects, including major, mini and applied hardware/software projects.
- Yes, RIZIQ provides IoT, robotics, embedded, software, mechanical and civil project support.
- Yes, RIZIQ provides research paper assistance and publication guidance. Authorship and results remain with the researcher.
- Yes, RIZIQ conducts technical workshops, Faculty Development Programs (FDP), Campus Recruitment Training (CRT) and campus development programs.
- Yes, RIZIQ supports MATLAB, VLSI foundations, CAD/CAE and engineering software training.
- RIZIQ does not guarantee journal acceptance and does not sell authorship.
